No waiting-for-reset loops.","acceptance_test":"ChatGPT selected and Codex forced auth or quota failure: Doctor, cockpit, terminal, and jobs do not spawn Claude; UI names ChatGPT + failure class; settings still ChatGPT; a labeled one-session override does not persist."},{"id":"A3","plan":"A","severity":"blocker","section":"Changes 5 Steward","problem":"Requirement A includes Steward cockpit. That is an unproven product assumption, not a design.","concrete_failure":"Shared resolver returns chatgpt + latest + Ultra; cockpit still builds Claude stream argv. Define freeze at new session/job/seat start, not mid-turn provider swap. Catalog cache must be deployment-local, revalidated on policy/CLI change, stale-flagged, never a distributable default. Historical fixtures stay historical.","acceptance_test":"Inventory table is the release checklist; a stale pin fixture fails unless the caller reads the resolver; cache in a clean profile is empty until that profile's CLI catalog is read; changing prefs during an active session does not rewrite that session's provider and the next session uses the new family."},{"id":"B1","plan":"B","severity":"blocker","section":"PUTER hosting and remote launch","problem":"v1 forbids a new reverse proxy, forbids bearer tokens in launch links/logs, forbids browser-facing localhost, and requires iPad Safari to run cells on the Anchor host. Those cannot all be true without specifying how Anchor-origin auth becomes Jupyter-origin kernel access. Observed: Jupyter on loopback 8890 and tailnet HTTPS 8446 with python3/ir; Week2 HTML opens notebooks; no fresh cell execution and no iPad/reboot proof. Direct Jupyter auth is a research spike labeled as a plan.","concrete_failure":"API returns a launch URL that works on the desktop via localhost or a tokenized 302 (token ends up in history) while iPad Safari hits a login loop, blocked mixed content, or a dead cookie after Jupyter reboot. Tests mark emulation as iPad proof.","required_revision":"Choose one launch architecture now: (1) Anchor `/notebook/<pid>?path=` that never puts a Jupyter token in HTML/register/logs and whose browser destination is proven on iPad after sign-in and after service reboot, or (2) Jupyter cookie/password on the tailnet HTTPS origin with Anchor links carrying only project/artifact id and a server-side redirect with no token in the client URL. Prove that choice against the live 8446 server before coding converters. Do not reuse ephemeral loopback preview_server as the Jupyter process manager.","acceptance_test":"From iPad Safari, Deliverables/Plan/Files open the same notebook on the Anchor host, a harmless python3 and ir cell run and save, reboot/on-boot recovery restores open-without-reimplementing-auth, and no new register row, log, or link contains a Jupyter token or localhost URL."},{"id":"B2","plan":"B","severity":"blocker","section":"Registration / shared.js","problem":"DELIVERABLES.md remains What|Where|Date|Step with a single Where. Plan puts notebook typing only on the parsed API. Companion .ipynb + provenance have no durable home in the register.","concrete_failure":"Resolver tests return language/kernel/launch fields while the markdown row still points at a .py and the existing row renderer downloads the .ipynb. Unconfigured projects can still show a live 'Open notebook - runs on PUTER' button if the frontend keys off extension.","required_revision":"Specify durable companion association (deterministic sibling + provenance next to artifacts, reflected in parse, not a second database). Preview_server loopback never reaches iPad.","required_revision":"One size cap with source-access fallback for all conversions.
